div.div:
CertWatch
Delivery pipeline (GitHub Actions to AWS)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 232px; height: 1px; padding-top: 141px; margin-left: 1570px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Arial; color: #232F3E; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

ol.li: Developer pushes a branch or opens a pull request.
The workflow lints, runs unit tests, then integration tests against LocalStack.
On main, the job exchanges its GitHub OIDC token for the deploy role; no stored AWS keys.
The role runs sam deploy, scoped to CertWatch stacks.
CloudFormation updates the dev stack first.
